Ferry service to run through winter

Two sailings a day will continue until March.

Filed under Transport

By Morag Sinclair

30 Jul 2026

The operator has confirmed that the Stromness route will keep two sailings a day through the winter timetable, reversing a decision taken in the spring.

Islanders had said the reduced service made hospital appointments on the mainland impossible to keep.
